title: codex-feature-annotation
description: One human-curated annotation file per feature flag (data/codex-features/annotations/<key>.json). `key` must equal the filename. Locale blocks live under `i18n`, keyed by BCP-47-style codes (zh, en, ja, zh-TW, zh-Hant, …); adding a language = adding one block. validate.mjs additionally checks the key exists in the extracted registry.

aka.description: Locale-independent observed official/user-facing name (e.g. chronicle = "Computer History").
